audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive mechanics are missing or vague. Wuju Style (14s) grants TRUE damage on his autos — the page only says 'melee DPS beats your self-peel', which reads as an armour problem it is not. Meditate is a 10-second channel that restores health and reduces damage taken, so it refunds your burst on a short timer and Grievous Wounds is the counter — no anti-heal advice exists anywhere. Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1, 600 range, UNTARGETABLE during the dash, and his basic attacks reduce its cooldown.
audit.why: 'Give up the 1v1' is the right conclusion for the wrong stated reason, and a player who buys armour into a true-damage steroid learns nothing from losing. The untargetable dash also explains why timed keg detonations whiff on his engage.
